about_the_game:
About the Game

Tycoon Land: Figurine Shop is a first-person management simulation where every detail of running a collectible figure store comes to life.

Design your shop to optimize both flow and fandom. Organize shelves, set up themed display tables, and create the ultimate experience for collectors who step through your doors.

Use your in-game computer to order new stock, unpack mystery boxes, and store rare figurines. Hand-paint your figures to increase their value, and arrange them strategically to attract curious buyers.

Manage your checkout like a pro—scan figures, process sales, and make sure each customer leaves with both a great purchase and a great memory.

Master the economics of the collectible market. Adjust prices based on rarity, market demand, and how well your store is decorated to keep clients browsing longer.

As your profits grow, reinvest in your business. Expand your shop, unlock new licenses, host miniature battle tournaments, and become the talk of the figurine community.

In Tycoon Land: Figurine Shop, every decision matters. Will you rise from a small corner shop to a legendary destination for collectors and fans?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 CPU @ 3.00GHz ; Shader Model 5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11, DX12 capable
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Run your own figurine shop! Order, paint, and display collectible figures, set your own prices, manage sales, and expand your store. Tournaments, mystery boxes, rare drops, and community events are just the beginning!
